decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting serves maritime clients but remains a narrow, distant niche with no later website evidence, so resources are better redirected to core LED lines.

The medical examination light uses our lighting know-how, but it sits outside the main industrial and building portfolio and its disappearance from later website material makes continuation less attractive than core development.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit our industrial customers, engineering strengths and certified manufacturing very well, so this remains a strategically relevant line to continue.
A pendant office luminaire is close to the core commercial lighting business and supports demand for efficient workplace LED solutions, so it is worth retaining unless superseded by a newer model.
The premium multi-model pendant line is a strong fit with the established offer and higher-value professional projects, making it a product family we should continue.
